openings.title: Admissions Counsellor
openings.summary: Guide students and parents through colleges, courses, scholarships and the common application.
does: Speak with students and parents about courses and colleges
Help students shortlist colleges and complete applications
Follow up and keep records of every conversation
needs: Good communication in Hindi and English
Basic comfort with Excel or Google Sheets

openings.title: Frontend Developer (React / Next.js)
openings.summary: Build and improve the Career Mantra website and student dashboard.
does: Build responsive pages in React and Next.js
Turn designs into clean, reusable components
Work with the backend team on APIs
needs: A GitHub profile or portfolio with projects

openings.title: Education Content Writer
openings.summary: Write college guides, exam updates and admission articles for students.
does: Research and write articles for the Career Mantra blog
Keep exam and admission information accurate and current
Edit and improve existing articles

openings.title: Web Development Intern
openings.summary: Learn by shipping real pages and features on a live education platform.
does: Build pages and components with React and Next.js
Fix bugs and improve the UI
Learn code review and Git workflow
needs: Basics of HTML, CSS and JavaScript

openings.title: Content Writing Intern
openings.summary: Write and research articles that help students choose colleges and exams.
does: Research colleges, courses and exams
Draft blog posts and news updates
Proofread and fact-check content
needs: Sample writing, if you have any

openings.title: Social Media and Marketing Intern
openings.summary: Help plan posts, campaigns and student outreach across our social channels.
does: Plan and create posts for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn
Support events and student campaigns
Track what works and suggest improvements
needs: Active on social media and creative

openings.title: Student Counselling Intern
openings.summary: Learn how admissions counselling works while supporting our counselling team.
does: Support counsellors in student calls and follow-ups
Maintain student records
Learn about colleges, courses and exams

values: Every decision starts with what helps a student choose better.
You work on real projects from the first week.
Take a task, see it through and own the result.
We share information that students can trust.
steps: Send your details and resume for the role you like.
A short call to understand your background and interest.
Talk to the team about the role, and a small task if needed.
If it is a match, you get an offer and a start date.
faqs: Yes. Internships are meant for students and freshers, and several jobs welcome 0–2 years of experience.
Each role lists its location and whether it is on-site, hybrid or remote.
How long does the process take?
We aim to respond quickly. A counsellor or the hiring team will contact you on the number you share.
I do not see a role for me. What should I do?
Send an open application with your resume. We keep it and reach out when a suitable role opens.
